summary: The framework asks the person for permission before an app tracks them across other companies' apps and websites. BifrOSt has no advertising or cross-app tracking identifier, so there is nothing to ask permission for. The permission manifest in springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs is the nearest counterpart and covers sandbox grants, not tracking.

features.note: BifrOSt apps get no cross-app tracking identifier, so no prompt is needed.

features.feature: Expanded interface and additional information action
features.note: Part of the same prompt; not applicable without tracking.
The manifest declares sandbox permissions such as keychain. It has no tracking key.
